name: Prototype Phobos
classType: Boss (Zombie Scenario: Season 1 - Last Clue); the first boss ever introduced in Zombie Scenario

profile.location: Rex Research Institute Sector Z; Lost City

tagline: Terror incarnate - the blue-skinned first boss waiting at the end of the Last Clue.
summary: Prototype Phobos is the first boss introduced to Zombie Scenario, encountered at the end of the Last Clue chapter (Season 1) in Sector Z of the Rex Research Institute beneath the Lost City. It has enormous health, a shockwave that forces players to drop their weapons, a slash attack and a lethal rush called Mahadash. Its evolved, purple-skinned form, Siege Type Phobos, is the final boss of the Chaos chapter. Defeating Phobos originally rewarded Phobos' DNA for item fusion (replaced after Zombie Scenario Re:boot).
story: Following the map found in the dead advance-unit commander Andrey's note, the rescue team reaches the Rex laboratory complex (Last Clue) and confronts Phobos in its final round. After about a minute of combat, zombies arrive to support it; the team must kill them and defeat Phobos to win. Phobos returns as the round-3 boss of Nightmare, and appears in Desert Plant, Hell Ride and Episode Choi; it is also the boss used in the Zombie Scenario tutorial. Siege Type Phobos, which appears in Chaos with a purple colour, has nearly identical properties.

abilities.name: Shockwave (Signature Secondary)
abilities.description: Produces a shockwave that forces players to drop their current weapon (notably resetting JANUS-series transformation counters).

abilities.name: Mahadash (rush attack)
abilities.description: A charging rush that can kill a player outright; survivors are knocked away and take fall damage. Can hit twice.

abilities.name: Stomp
abilities.description: A stomp attack later borrowed by the infected Dr. Rex.

abilities.name: Zombie reinforcements
abilities.description: After roughly one minute of combat, zombies spawn to assist Phobos.

relatedCharacters: Dr. Rex - creator; his infected form copies Phobos's stomp
Andrey (advance unit commander) and Felix (signal corpsman) - storyline NPCs whose notes lead to Phobos
tips: Max out attack and health upgrades before round 2; favour high-fire-rate, large-magazine weapons (SKULL and BALROG series, MG3, M134 Minigun) or explosive spam (M79 Saw Off); aim for the head with machine guns; keep moving in one flow, avoid traps and avoid colliding with teammates.
trivia: The first boss introduced in Zombie Scenario.
Named after Phobos, the Greek personification of fear (the word means 'terror'), and also the moon of Mars.
Sometimes fails to appear in Last Clue; using a Round Retry fixes it.
Rewards on defeat (pre-Re:boot): Phobos' DNA, fusable with items from Lost City, Double Gate and Trap.
